name: grow a surface from a front edge, adding one triangle at a time
mechanism: start from a seed triangle; keep the boundary edges as a front; for each front edge choose the nearby point that forms the best-shaped triangle satisfying a local empty-sphere test, add it, and update the front; stop when the front is empty

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Marching triangles' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: reconstruct two-dimensional surface geometry from an unstructured point cloud

requires: a point cloud dense relative to surface curvature
fails_when: holes where sampling is sparse; fronts can collide
